mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 200 (as of the most recent monthly reading) signals stable inflation that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 200, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a synchronized economic expansion that drives corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO increase and UNRATE decrease does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in regression has negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC is positive over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST level above 1500 (thousands of units) signals robust residential construction activity that supports consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 136,000 signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when PAYEMS > 136000, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong supply-side expansion and labor market tightening, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO increase and UNRATE decrease does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in regression has negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (RSAFS > 360,000), sustained consumer spending drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when RSAFS > 360000 and economy is in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.
